title: mimi-mls: join_external carries AppDataUpdates (participant-list addition for open join / join links)
description: Found 2026-11-16 implementing mimid-1wgh.12.46. Member::join_external (crates/mimi-mls/src/member.rs:786) takes no AppDataUpdates, but the hub refuses a non-member's external Commit that does not add the joiner to the participant list (hub/policy.rs authorize_commit, Committer::External; open join under canOpenJoin, room-policy-04 §8.1.1; join links §6.2). So no mimi-mls client can open-join or rejoin a room after leaving; adding another client of a user already listed works. Add an app_updates parameter (inline AppDataUpdate proposals in the external Commit, as Member::commit takes), then extend tests/jmap_two_providers.rs step 9 to a room whose role 0 holds canOpenJoin: alice rejoins, her Chat is bound again (Chat.roomId), and she decrypts bob's next message.
close_reason: 9fdc72b: Member::join_external_with; full JMAP rejoin in jmap_two_providers step 9.
